sources.title: Schuler Basic Principles of Hydroforming
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: 粉末冶金齒輪製造
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：明確使用中徑與局部厚度，概念應力與實際成形極限分開。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Mean diameter and local thickness are explicit, with stress scaling separate from actual forming limits.
related.difference: 以環形近似核對齒輪坯重量，將齒根局部孔隙與整體密度分開驗收。
related.differenceEn: Check blank mass with an annular approximation and assess local tooth-root porosity separately from bulk density.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 封閉薄壁圓管的環向應力 σθ=pD/(2t)；此處只作彈性受力尺度，不能當成成形壓力配方。 純教學 p=1 MPa、中徑 D=40 mm、厚度 t=1 mm；忽略端部與接觸。 σθ=1×40/(2×1)=20 MPa；D/t=40，仍須檢查薄壁假設與局部曲率。
環形體積 V=π(Do²−Di²)b/4，質量 m=ρsolid×relative density×V；齒槽另扣。 合成等效環形外徑 60 mm、內徑 20 mm、寬 10 mm；實體密度 7.8 g/cm³，相對密度 0.90。 V=8π cm³=25.1327 cm³；m=7.8×0.90×8π=176.4318 g。模型尚未扣齒槽。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: For a thin circular tube σθ=pD/(2 t); use it only as a stress scale, not a hydroforming-pressure recipe. Teaching p=1 MPa, mean diameter 40 mm, wall 1 mm; omit end and contact effects. σθ=1×40/(2×1)=20 MPa; D/t=40, with thin-wall and local-curvature assumptions still explicit.

Annular volume V=π(Do²−Di²)b/4 and m=ρ solid×relative density×V, with tooth spaces deducted separately. Synthetic equivalent annulus OD 60, ID 20, width 10 mm; solid density 7.8 g/cm³ and relative density 0.90. V=8 π cm³=25.1327 cm³; m=7.8×0.90×8 π=176.4318 g, before tooth-space subtraction.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 工業機器人運動學
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：明確使用中徑與局部厚度，概念應力與實際成形極限分開。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Mean diameter and local thickness are explicit, with stress scaling separate from actual forming limits.
related.difference: 從關節相對角推導末端位置，辨認第二連桿使用累積角而非單獨角。
related.differenceEn: Derive endpoint position from relative joint angles, using the accumulated second-link angle.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 封閉薄壁圓管的環向應力 σθ=pD/(2t)；此處只作彈性受力尺度，不能當成成形壓力配方。 純教學 p=1 MPa、中徑 D=40 mm、厚度 t=1 mm；忽略端部與接觸。 σθ=1×40/(2×1)=20 MPa；D/t=40，仍須檢查薄壁假設與局部曲率。
x=L1cosθ1+L2cos(θ1+θ2)，y=L1sinθ1+L2sin(θ1+θ2)；此模型只涵蓋平面位置。 教學L1=0.4 m、L2=0.3 m，θ1=0°、θ2=90°；角度均為相對前一連桿。 x=0.4 m、y=0.3 m，距原點√(0.4²+0.3²)=0.5 m；距離不是兩連桿總長。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: For a thin circular tube σθ=pD/(2 t); use it only as a stress scale, not a hydroforming-pressure recipe. Teaching p=1 MPa, mean diameter 40 mm, wall 1 mm; omit end and contact effects. σθ=1×40/(2×1)=20 MPa; D/t=40, with thin-wall and local-curvature assumptions still explicit.

x=L 1 cos θ1+L 2 cos(θ1+θ2), y=L 1 sin θ1+L 2 sin(θ1+θ2); the model covers planar position only. Teaching L 1=0.4 m, L 2=0.3 m, θ1=0°, θ2=90°, each relative to the preceding link. x=0.4 m, y=0.3 m and radius 0.5 m; endpoint radius is not total link length.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
